payload.body: You tend to choose a role that offers growth and then struggle with the cooperation it expects, or choose independence and leave an important skill undeveloped. Neither side can simply be removed from the plan. This often comes from treating progress as something that has to be either fully self-directed or fully approved. Change one expectation while keeping the part of the direction that still matters.
payload.astroHint: Lilith quincunx the North Node can make a new direction and the need for autonomy require repeated adjustments.
